IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Representatives Carrell, Bush, Cox, Kristiansen and Talcott

Bill.BriefDescription: Providing immunity for persons rendering assistance to residents at certain facilities.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing immunity for persons renderingassistance to residents at facilities under chapters 18.51, 18.20,70.128, and 70.38 RCW; and adding a new section to chapter 4.24 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 4.24 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A nursing home facility under chapter 18.51 RCW, a boarding homeproviding assisted living services under chapter 18.20 RCW, an adultfamily home under chapter 70.128 RCW, or a continuing care retirementcommunity under RCW 70.38.025, and its employees or volunteers, shallnot be liable for civil damages as a result of any act or omission inproviding assistance to a resident of the facility when the facility,employee, or volunteer, without gross negligence or willful or wantonmisconduct, provides assistance to a resident of the facility who hasfallen and the resident requests assistance in rising or indicates heor she will accept assistance in rising.
